Subject: De meest opvallende retailtrends van 2023

Dear Team,

Ik hoop dat u het goed geniet met de start van de zomer! Ik wilde u een kort update geven over de meest opvallende retailtrends van 2023, op basis van onze meest recente analyses.

1. Duurzaamheid is de nieuwe norm
Klanten geven steeds meer om duurzaamheid en transparantie. Bedrijven moeten zich richten op circulaire productieprocessen en duurzame materialen. Ook de hergebruik van verpakkingen is een belangrijk thema.

2. Persoonlijke ervaringen zijn belangrijker dan ooit
Om de concurrentie aan te gaan, moeten winkels zich richten op het bieden van persoonlijke ervaringen. Dit kan door middel van hyperpersoonlijke aanbiedingen, gebaseerd op eerdere aankopen en voorkeuren van klanten.

3. Online en offline integreren
De grenzen tussen online en offline shopping vervagen steeds meer. On-demand levering, BOPIS (Buy Online Pick-up In Store) en showrooming zijn slechts enkele voorbeelden van hoe bedrijven deze trend omarmen.

4. Sociale media spelen een cruciale rol
Sociale media zijn een belangrijke bron van inspiratie en informatie voor consumenten. Bedrijven moeten zich richten op het creëren van authentieke en interessante inhoud om klanten te bereiken en te binden.

5. KI en machine learning veranderen de retailsector
KI en machine learning helpen bedrijven beter te begrijpen hoe klanten denken en handelen. Dit leidt tot betere beslissingen en efficiëntere processen.

We hopen dat deze trends u inspiratie geven voor uw eigen retailstrategieën. Als u vragen of opmerkingen hebt, laat het ons dan gerust wet

I. Introducción

Estimado inversionista,

En Inversiones Sostenibles S.A., nos enorgullece presentarle nuestra última oportunidad de inversión en proyectos de energía renovable. Nuestra empresa se ha especializado en la identificación y promoción de proyectos que no solo generan un rendimiento financiero atractivo, sino que también contribuyen a la preservación del medio ambiente y el avance de las energías limpias.

En este prospecto, encontrará una descripción detallada de los objetivos, riesgos y términos de esta inversión, así como una evaluación exhaustiva de su impacto ambiental, proyecciones financieras y consideraciones regulatorias.

II. Objetivos del proyecto

Pago de Usted = Notional x (Tasa Flotante - Tasa Fija) x Días del Período / Días de Año

- Días del Período y Días de Año se definen en el Acuerdo Marco de Derivados de la ISDA (2002) ("ISDA FMBA").

(b) El pago de intereses de Nosotros a Usted se calculará utilizando la fórmula:

Policy för tvistelösning genom adjudikation

Syfte
------------

Denna policy beskriver processen för att lösa tvister som uppstår mellan parter inom bolaget eller med externa parter genom adjudikation. Syftet med denna policy är att säkerställa en rättssäker, effektiv och rättvis tvistelösning som respekterar parternas rättigheter och intressen.

Adjudikationsprocessen
--------------------

1. **Anmälan:** En part ska först anmäla tvisten genom att skicka en skriftlig anmälan till den andra parten och till adjudikatorn. Anmälan ska innehålla en kort beskrivning av tvisten, de inblandade parterna och en begäran om en viss lösning.

2. **Utredning:** Adjudikatorn ska sedan samla in och granska alla relevanta bevis och information relaterade till tvisten. Adjudikatorn kan begära ytterligare information från parterna och kan hålla möten med parterna för att diskutera tvisten.

3. **Beslut:** Efter att ha granskat alla bevis och information ska adjudikatorn fatta ett beslut om tvisten. Beslutet ska vara skriftligt och motiverat. Adjudikatorns beslut är bindande för parterna och ska respekteras.

4. **Uppföljning:** Om någon part inte uppfyller adjudikatorns beslut ska bolaget vidta de nödvändiga åtgärderna för att se till att beslutet uppfylls.

In Deutschland müssen sich alle Unternehmen der Automobilindustrie an bestimmte Vorschriften und Standards halten, um die Sicherheit der Fahrzeuge und den Schutz der Verbraucher zu gewährleisten. In diesem Leitfaden werden die wichtigsten Anforderungen und Vorschriften für die Automobilindustrie erläutert.

1. Fahrzeugsicherheitsinspektionen

Alle Fahrzeuge, die in Deutschland verkauft werden, müssen einer gründlichen Sicherheitsinspektion unterzogen werden, bevor sie auf den Markt gebracht werden. Dazu gehören auch Fahrzeuge, die importiert werden. Die Inspektionen sollen sicherstellen, dass das Fahrzeug den deutschen Sicherheitsstandards entspricht und dass es sicher für den Straßenverkehr ist.

2. Emissionsprüfungen

Alle Fahrzeuge, die in Deutschland verkauft werden, müssen auch einer Emissionsprüfung unterzogen werden, um sicherzustellen, dass sie den Emissionsstandards entsprechen. Die Emissionsprüfungen werden von autorisierten Prüfstellen durchgeführt und müssen alle zwei Jahre wiederholt werden.

3. Automobilindustrie-Vorschriften und -Standards

Alle Unternehmen der Automobilindustrie müssen sich an die Vorschriften und Standards der Branche halten, einschließlich der Vorschriften für Fahrzeugsicherheit, Emissionen und Verbraucherschutz. Dazu gehören auch die Vorschriften für Fahrzeugrückrufe und die Verbraucherinformationen.

4. Fahrzeugrückrufe

Informativa di Divulgazione del Prodotto - Investimento nel Turismo

Data: 01/01/2023

1. Introduzione

La presente Informativa di Divulgazione del Prodotto riguarda l'investimento nel fondo "Viaggi nel Futuro" (il "Fondo"), gestito da Investimenti S.p.A. Il Fondo mira a fornire agli investitori un'esposizione diversificata alle opportunità di crescita nel settore del turismo e dei viaggi, investendo in società quotate e non quotate attive nel settore dei viaggi e del turismo, comprese compagnie aeree, alberghi, società di gestione di destinazioni turistiche e fornitori di servizi di viaggio.

2. Caratteristiche del Fondo

Il Fondo è aperto a investitori qualificati e istituzionali e ha un patrimonio minimo iniziale di 50 milioni di euro. Il Fondo mira a fornire una crescita del capitale a lungo termine attraverso investimenti a medio e lungo termine in società del settore dei viaggi e del turismo. Il Fondo prevede di investire almeno l'80% del suo patrimonio in società del settore dei viaggi e del turismo e può investire fino al 20% del suo patrimonio in strumenti finanziari correlati o in altri settori.

3. Rischi

Gli investimenti nel Fondo sono soggetti a una serie di rischi, tra cui:

- Rischio di mercato: Il valore degli investimenti del Fondo può fluttuare a causa delle condizioni di mercato generali.
- Rischio di credito: Il Fondo può essere esposto al rischio di credito se le società in cui investe non sono in grado di adempiere ai loro obblighi finanziari.
- Rischio di concentrazione: Il Fondo può essere esposto al rischio di concentrazione se investe in un numero limit

**Krisledningsplan för Thijn P. Verbeeck AB**

**Inledning**

Den här krisledningsplanen har utformats för Thijn P. Verbeeck AB för att stödja företaget i att hantera oväntade händelser och kriser. Den här planen definierar roller och ansvarsområden, etablerar kommunikationsprotokoll och innehåller riktlinjer för krisberedskap och respons.

**Krisberedskap**

Vi vid Thijn P. Verbeeck AB erkänner vikten av att vara förberedda på kriser och oväntade händelser. För att uppnå detta har vi etablerat följande principer:

- **Kontinuerlig utvärdering:** Vi utvärderar regelbundet våra krisberedskapsmål och -processer för att säkerställa att de är upp-to-date och effektiva.
- **Träning:** Vi erbjuder regelbundna övningar och utbildningar för vårt ledarskap och personal för att säkerställa att de är välförberedda att hantera kriser.
- **Kommunikation:** Vi etablerar klara och effektiva kommunikationsprotokoll för att säkerställa att information kan delas snabbt och korrekt under en kris.

**Krisrespons**

I händelse av en kris ska följande steg vidtas:

1. **Bekräfta krisen:** Lukas, som är ansvarig för krisberedskap, ska bekräfta att en kris har inträffat och utvärdera dess allvarlighet.
2. **Samla information:** Lukas ska samla in relevant information och uppdatera ledarskapet och personalen.
3. **Beslut:** Ledarskapet ska ta ett snabbt och avgörande beslut om hur kris

Regleringskommitténs Handbok för Byggnadskomplians

Välkomna till Regleringskommitténs handbok för byggnadskomplians. Denna handbok är avsedd att hjälpa byggföretag att följa de regler och standarder som gäller inom byggbranschen. I denna handbok får ni information om hur ni ska genomföra säkerhetskontroller, hantera byggavfall och se till att ni följer byggkoder och arbetsmiljölagar.

Säkerhetskontroller

För att säkerställa att alla arbetare och besökare på en byggplats är trygga, måste ni utför regelbundna säkerhetskontroller. Ni bör kontrollera att all arbetsutrustning är i god skick och att alla säkerhetsföreskrifter följs. Ni bör också se till att alla arbetare har fått rätt säkerhetsutbildning och att de använder skyddsutrustning när det behövs.

Exempel: Under en säkerhetskontroll kan ni kontrollera att arbetaren Dominic Phillips har fått rätt skyddsutrustning, inklusive hjälm, handskar och stövlar. Ni bör också se till att hans arbetsplats är fri från faror, till exempel oljiga fläckar eller lösa kablar.

Hantera byggavfall

Byggavfall måste hanteras på ett sätt som minimerar miljöpåverkan. Ni bör sortera avfallet så att det kan återvinnas eller återanvändas så mycket som möjligt. Ni bör också se till att avfallet transporteras och slängs på ett säkert och miljövänligt sätt.

text:
Linee Guida per la Governance Aziendale: Piano di Gestione delle Crisi

1. Scopo e Ambito

Queste Linee Guida per la Governance Aziendale definiscono il Piano di Gestione delle Crisi per l'azienda XYZ S.p.A., con l'obiettivo di fornire una struttura e un insieme di principi e pratiche che guidino il Consiglio di Amministrazione e la Direzione nella gestione delle crisi aziendali. Il presente Piano di Gestione delle Crisi si applica a tutte le situazioni di crisi, inclusi, a titolo esemplificativo ma non esaustivo, disastri naturali, violazioni della sicurezza informatica e minacce alla reputazione.

2. Struttura e Operazioni

2.1 Ruoli e Responsabilità

Il Consiglio di Amministrazione è responsabile della supervisione e dell'approvazione del Piano di Gestione delle Crisi, mentre la Direzione è responsabile della sua attuazione e del suo aggiornamento continuo. Verrà nominato un Comitato di Crisi, composto da membri del Consiglio di Amministrazione e della Direzione, che si riunirà regolarmente per discutere e affrontare le questioni relative alla gestione delle crisi.

2.2 Comunicazione

La comunicazione è un elemento chiave del Piano di Gestione delle Crisi. Verrà stabilito un protocollo di comunicazione che definisca i canali, le tempistiche e i destinatari appropriati per la comunicazione interna ed esterna durante una situazione di crisi.

3. Gestione della Crisi

3.1 Identificazione e Valutazione della Crisi

Il Comitato di Crisi è responsabile dell'identificazione e della valutazione delle situazioni di crisi. Verrà definito un processo per la segnalazione e l'escalation delle situazioni di crisi, al fine di garantire una risposta tempestiva ed efficace.

PROSPECTUS D'INVESTISSEMENT

I. Introduction

Le présent prospectus d'investissement a pour but de fournir des informations détaillées sur une opportunité d'investissement dans un démarrage technologique prometteur. Ce document décrit les objectifs, les risques et les modalités de l'investissement proposé.

II. Processus de sélection des startups technologiques

1. Identification des startups prometteuses : Nous identifions les startups technologiques prometteuses grâce à une veille technologique et marché approfondie. Nous recherchons des entreprises ayant des produits ou services innovants, un potentiel de croissance élevé et une équipe de direction compétente.
2. Évaluation préliminaire : Nous évaluons chaque startup en fonction de critères tels que la taille du marché cible, la concurrence, le modèle d'affaires, la traction initiale et la stratégie de monétisation.
3. Sélection finale : Les startups répondant à nos critères sont invitées à présenter leur projet devant notre comité d'investissement. Seules les entreprises ayant démontré un fort potentiel de réussite sont retenues.

III. Due diligence et évaluation des risques et récompenses

1. Due diligence : Avant d'investir, nous menons une enquête approfondie sur la startup, y compris l'analyse financière, l'examen juridique, la vérification des antécédents de l'équipe de direction et l'évaluation de la technologie sous-jacente.
2. Évaluation des risques : Nous identifions et évaluons tous les risques potentiels, y compris les risques technologiques, de marché, de réglementation, de concurrence et de gestion.
3. Évaluation des récompenses : Nous estimons le potentiel de rendement de l'investissement en fonction de facteurs tels que la taille potentielle du marché

POLITIQUE DE RÉSOLUTION DES LITIGES EN COLLABORATION

Chez notre entreprise, nous sommes déterminés à offrir un environnement dans lequel les différends entre les parties prenantes, qu'il s'agisse d'employés, de clients ou de tiers, peuvent être résolus de manière équitable, transparente et constructive. Notre politique de résolution des litiges en collaboration met l'accent sur la coopération et cherche à éviter les litiges en favorisant un dialogue ouvert et honnête.

1. Champ d'application

La présente politique de résolution des litiges en collaboration s'applique à tous les différends survenant entre les parties prenantes de notre entreprise, y compris, mais sans s'y limiter, les employés, les clients, les fournisseurs et les partenaires commerciaux.

2. Définition d'un litige

Aux fins de la présente politique, un litige est défini comme toute divergence d'opinions ou d'intérêts entre deux ou plusieurs parties, susceptible de perturber la relation ou les opérations commerciales.

3. Engagement en faveur de la collaboration

Les parties s'engagent à résoudre les litiges de manière collaborative, en évitant les procédures judiciaires et en recherchant activement des solutions mutuellement bénéfiques.

4. Processus de résolution des litiges

4.1 Identification du litige
La première étape du processus de résolution des litiges consiste à identifier et à reconnaître l'existence du litige. Les parties doivent clairement exprimer leurs préoccupations et leurs intérêts respectifs.

4.2 Nomination d'un facilitateur
Les parties doivent convenir d'un facilitateur neutre, qui peut être un membre du personnel ou un tiers extérieur à l'entreprise. Le rôle du facilitateur est de guider les parties dans le processus de résolution des litiges et de s'assurer que la communication est ouverte, respectueuse

"Lignes directrices en matière de gouvernance d'entreprise : Cadre de rémunération des dirigeants

Introduction

Ces lignes directrices en matière de gouvernance d'entreprise visent à établir un cadre de rémunération des dirigeants transparent et axé sur la performance, aligné sur la stratégie à long terme de l'entreprise. Ce cadre comprend une combinaison de composantes fixes et variables, des dispositions de récupération et la divulgation des détails de rémunération dans les rapports annuels pour assurer la responsabilité et l'alignement avec les intérêts des actionnaires.

Composantes de la rémunération

1. Rémunération fixe : La rémunération fixe est un montant prédéterminé versé aux dirigeants, indépendamment des performances de l'entreprise.

2. Rémunération variable : La rémunération variable est liée aux performances de l'entreprise et est versée en fonction des objectifs atteints. Les critères de performance doivent être clairs, mesurables et alignés sur la stratégie à long terme de l'entreprise.

Dispositions de récupération

Les dispositions de récupération, également appelées clawback provisions, permettent à l'entreprise de récupérer une partie ou la totalité de la rémunération versée aux dirigeants si des informations financières incorrectes ou trompeuses sont découvertes.

Divulgation dans les rapports annuels

L'entreprise doit divulguer les détails de la rémunération des dirigeants dans ses rapports annuels, y compris la rémunération fixe et variable, les dispositions de récupération et tout autre élément de rémunération.

Exemple d'application

Conformément à ces lignes directrices, la rémunération du Directeur général, M. Claes E. Franzén, résidant au 51 Acceso de Lucía Pereira, 07184, León, pour l'année 2022

1. **Compensation Structure**
   The company's executive compensation framework shall consist of a mix of fixed and variable components. The variable component, or incentive-based compensation, shall be tied to the company's performance and individual performance metrics.

   The variable component of the executive compensation shall be structured to reward performance and align the interests of executives with those of shareholders. The performance metrics shall be clearly defined, measurable, and aligned with the company's long-term strategy.

   The company shall incorporate clawback provisions in its executive compensation framework. These provisions shall allow the company to recoup incentive-based compensation in cases of financial restatements, misconduct, or failure to meet performance targets.

   The company shall disclose the details of its executive compensation framework in its annual reports. In conformità con le normative vigenti, forniremo la nostra piena cooperazione nel processo di riferimento giudiziale. Di seguito sono riportati i passaggi specifici che seguiremo:

3. Partecipazione Obbligatoria: Le parti in disputa sono tenute a partecipare attivamente al metodo di risoluzione delle controversie selezionato e a fornire tutta la documentazione e le informazioni richieste.

4. Risoluzione della Controversia: Una volta completato il processo di risoluzione delle controversie, il terzo imparziale fornirà una decisione vincolante o una raccomandazione che le parti in disputa possono accettare o rifiutare.

Supply Chain Management

Einführung

Das Jahr 2021 war für uns ein Jahr des Wandels und der Anpassung. Die globale Pandemie und die sich ständig weiterentwickelnden Marktbedingungen stellten unsere Lieferkette auf eine harte Probe. I. Introduction

This guide outlines the regulatory requirements and standards that transportation companies must adhere to within the industry and jurisdiction of Sweden. The purpose of this guide is to ensure the safety and security of all parties involved, including drivers, passengers, and cargo.

II. Fleet Maintenance

1. Vehicle Inspections: Regular vehicle inspections are mandatory to ensure the safety of the vehicle and its compliance with transportation regulations. Inspections should be conducted in accordance with the guidelines set forth by the Swedish Transport Agency (Transportstyrelsen).
2. Maintenance Records: Companies must maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all vehicle maintenance and repairs. These records must be kept for a minimum of two years and be readily available upon request by the Swedish Transport Agency.

III. Driver Training

1. Licensing: Drivers must possess a valid Swedish driver's license and any necessary endorsements for the type of vehicle they will be operating.
2. Background Checks: Companies must conduct thorough background checks on all drivers, including a check of the driver's criminal record.
3. Training: Companies must provide regular training for drivers, including training on safety regulations, defensive driving techniques, and emergency procedures.

IV. Transportation Safety Regulations

1. Cargo Handling: Companies must adhere to strict guidelines for cargo handling, including proper loading, securing, and unloading of cargo.
2. Hours of Service: Drivers must comply with hours of service regulations, including maximum driving time and mandatory rest periods.
3. Emergency Procedures: Companies must have emergency procedures in place, including procedures for handling accidents, breakdowns, and other emergencies.

Subject: Geniet van deze gezonde leefstijl tips en inspirerende verhalen!

Beste Madeleine Fernandez-Turpin,

We hope this email finds you in good health and high spirits. Wij willen je inspireren en ondersteunen bij het behouden van een gezonde leefstijl. Daarom hebben we een aantal waardevolle tips, educatieve inhoud en motiverende verhalen voor je verzameld.

Voordat we beginnen, wij willen je herinneren aan je laatste gezondheidscheck-up op 14 april 2003 om 01:04:57. Als je vragen hebt over je resultaten of je gezondheidsstatus, laat het ons dan weten. We zijn hier om je te helpen.

Tip 1: Voer minstens 30 minuten lichaamsbeweging uit per dag. Probeer dit te combineren met een gezonde, evenwichtige dieet.

Tip 2: Drink minimaal 8 glazen water per dag om je lichaam goed gehydrateerd te houden.

Tip 3: Zorg ervoor dat je voldoende slaapt. Volwassenen hebben gemiddeld 7-9 uur slaap per nacht nodig.

1. Objetivo del Plan

El objetivo del Plan es proporcionar a la Empleada un beneficio de jubilación objetivo basado en su edad y años de servicio, sujeto a las disposiciones de este Acuerdo.

2. Contribuciones

Beneficio de jubilación = (Años de servicio x Salario base anual) / 50

Donde:

* "Años de servicio" se refiere al número total de años de servicio continuo de la Empleada en la Empresa.
* "Salario base anual" se refiere al salario base anual de la Empleada en el momento del cálculo del beneficio.

¡Bienvenido al Fondo de Energía Limpia!

El Fondo de Energía Limpia es un fondo de inversión que se especializa en proyectos de energía renovable y sostenible. Nuestro objetivo es ofrecer a los inversionistas la oportunidad de participar en el crecimiento de la industria de energía limpia, al tiempo que se promueve la sostenibilidad y se reduce la huella de carbono.

Objetivos del Fondo
------------------

Nuestro objetivo es invertir en empresas y proyectos que promuevan la energía renovable y sostenible, incluyendo:

* Energía eólica
* Energía solar
* Energía hidroeléctrica
* Almacenamiento de energía
* Eficiencia energética
* Tecnologías de captura y almacenamiento de carbono

Nuestra estrategia de inversión se basa en identificar oportunidades de inversión en etapas tempranas y en empresas y proyectos con un alto potencial de crecimiento y un impacto positivo en el medio ambiente.

Estrategia de Inversión
-----------------------

Nuestra estrategia de inversión se basa en los siguientes criterios:

* Alineación con los Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible de las Naciones Unidas
* Potencial de crecimiento y retorno de la inversión
* Impacto positivo en el medio ambiente y la sociedad
* Experiencia y trayectoria del equipo gerencial
* Diversificación del portafolio

Riesgos
------

Como con cualquier inversión, existen riesgos asociados con la inversión en el Fondo de Energía Limpia. Estos riesgos incluyen, pero no se limitan a:

* Riesgo de mercado: Los precios de las acciones y los bonos pueden fluctuar y afectar el valor de la inversión.
* Riesgo de crédito

Inleiding

Hartelijk dank voor het bekijken van onze prospectus voor onze Fonds voor Groene Energie Investeren. Dit fonds biedt beleggers de kans om hun portefeuille te diversificeren met een groeiende en duurzame beleggingscategorie. Onze doelstelling is het bieden van hoge rendementen door middel van investeringen in groene energieprojecten, terwijl we tegelijkertijd een positieve impact willen hebben op het milieu.

Fondsdoelstellingen

Het doel van ons Fonds voor Groene Energie Investeren is het genereren van hoge rendementen voor onze beleggers door middel van investeringen in groene energieprojecten. Dit omvat zowel de ontwikkeling als de exploitatie van projecten in de volgende sectoren:

* Zonne-energie
* Windenergie
* Waterkracht
* Biomassa
* Geothermische energie

Door middel van onze expertise en ervaring willen we de beste projecten identificeren en ondersteunen, zodat we uiteindelijk hoge rendementen kunnen genereren voor onze beleggers.

Investeringsstrategie

Om onze doelstellingen te bereiken, zullen we onze expertise en ervaring gebruiken om de beste projecten te identificeren en te ondersteunen. Dit omvat de volgende stappen:

1. Identificatie van potentiële projecten: We zullen onze netwerk en expertise gebruiken om potentiële projecten te identificeren, met een focus op projecten die een positieve impact hebben op het milieu.
2. Beoordeling van projecten: Nadat we potentiële projecten hebben geïdentificeerd, zullen we een grondige beoordeling van elk project doorvoeren, met een focus op de financiële haalbaarheid en de potentiële milie

Wanneer een geschil tussen partijen ontstaat, bieden wij een Sessie voor Schikking aan. Deze sessie wordt geleid door een onafhankelijke bemiddelaar die beide partijen helpt om een wederzijds aanvaardbare oplossing te bereiken.

Proces voor Schikking:

1. Indien u een geschil met ons hebt, neem dan contact op met ons klantendienstteam.
2. Het klantendienstteam zal uw klacht onderzoeken en proberen om een oplossing te bieden. Als uw klacht niet is opgelost of als u ontevreden bent over de oplossing, kunt u verzoeken om een Sessie voor Schikking.
3. Wanneer u een Sessie voor Schikking aanvraagt, zal ons klantendienstteam uw verzoek doorsturen naar de onafhankelijke bemiddelaar.
4. De onafhankelijke bemiddelaar zal contact opnemen met beide partijen om een geschikte datum en tijd voor de sessie vast te stellen.
5. Tijdens de Sessie voor Schikking zal de onafhankelijke bemiddelaar beide partijen toelaten om hun kant van het verhaal te vertellen en zal hij/zij proberen om een wederzijds aanvaardbare oplossing te bereiken.
6. Als de partijen het oneens zijn over de uitslag van de Sessie voor Schikking, kunnen zij overgaan naar een formele rechtszaak.

Inleiding

Als telecomaanbieder opereert u in een strikt gereguleerde markt. Deze regelgeleide richtlijn biedt een overzicht van de belangrijkste beveiligings-, infrastructuur- en privacyvereisten waaraan u moet voldoen.

* Netwerkfirewalls: Implementeer en onderhoud firewalls om ongewenste toegang tot uw netwerk te voorkomen.
* Intrusiedetectie en -preventiesystemen (IDPS): Implementeer IDPS om netwerkactiviteiten in realtime te controleren en op te treden bij vermoede inbraakpogingen.
* Authenticatie en autorisatie: Implementeer strenge authenticatie- en autorisatieprotocollen om onbevoegde toegang tot persoonlijke gegevens te voorkomen.

Voorbeeld:

Jose Ramón Guardia (passport_number: X45929398) verwacht dat u alle nodige maatregelen neemt om zijn persoonlijke gegevens te beschermen. U moet bijvoorbeeld ervoor zorgen dat alle toegang tot de klantgegevens (zoals op 7 Tristandreef, Stadskanaal) beveiligd is met sterkere authenticatie- en autorisatieprotocollen.

Infrastructuurbeheer

Als telecomaanbieder moet u ook efficiënt en betrouwbaar infrastructuurbeheer bieden. Hieronder volgen enkele belangrijke infrastructuurvereisten:

* Netwerkmonitoring: Implementeer

POLITIQUE DE CONFIDENTIALITÉ DES ENFANTS

Chez [Nom de la société], nous prenons la vie privée des enfants très au sérieux. Nous nous engageons à protéger la confidentialité de nos jeunes utilisateurs et à obtenir le consentement des parents avant de collecter des informations personnelles identifiables (PII). Cette politique de confidentialité des enfants explique comment nous collectons, utilisons et gérons les données des enfants, y compris les mesures de protection de la vie privée et les droits des parents.

Collecte de données

Nous ne collectons pas sciemment de PII auprès d'enfants de moins de 13 ans, sauf si nous avons obtenu le consentement vérifiable des parents ou si la collecte est autorisée par la loi. Si nous découvrons que nous avons collecté des PII auprès d'un enfant sans le consentement vérifiable des parents, nous prendrons des mesures raisonnables pour supprimer ces informations dès que possible.

Lorsque nous collectons des PII auprès d'enfants, nous ne demandons que les informations strictement nécessaires pour permettre la participation à une activité spécifique. Les PII que nous pouvons collecter peuvent inclure des éléments tels que le customer_id (par exemple, A7437434) et le nom (par exemple, Mohammed Peronne-Haengreve). Nous ne demandons jamais de renseignements sensibles, tels que des numéros de sécurité sociale ou des informations médicales.

Utilisation des données

Nous utilisons les PII collectées auprès des enfants uniquement dans le but de fournir et d'améliorer nos services. Par exemple, nous pouvons utiliser le customer_id pour suivre les progrès d'un enfant dans un jeu éducatif. Nous ne partageons ni ne vendons jamais les PII des enfants à des tiers à des fins publicitaires ou de marketing.

Gestion des données

Fecha: Martes, 4 de Marzo de 1986

I. INTRODUCCIÓN

Estimado Inversionista,

En Inversiones Harrison, nos complace presentarle nuestro Prospecto de Inversión en el sector de Telecomunicaciones. Nuestra empresa, con sede en 00 Juliana-Trapp-Straße, Apt. 2/5, ha identificado oportunidades clave en este sector en constante evolución y desea ofrecerle la posibilidad de formar parte de ellas.

II. OBJETIVOS

Nuestro objetivo primordial es invertir en empresas de Telecomunicaciones que muestren un sólido desempeño financiero, un gran potencial de crecimiento y una clara ventaja competitiva. Buscamos empresas que aprovechen las últimas tecnologías y se adapten a los cambiantes marcos regulatorios.

III. RIESGOS

Invertir en el sector de Telecomunicaciones conlleva ciertos riesgos, incluyendo la volatilidad del mercado, la incertidumbre regulatoria y la rápida evolución tecnológica. Sin embargo, nuestro equipo de expertos ha identificado estrategias para mitigar estos riesgos y maximizar el retorno de la inversión.

IV. ANÁLISIS DEL SECTOR

1. Tecnologías: El sector de Telecomunicaciones se caracteriza por una rápida evolución tecnológica. Desde la telefonía móvil hasta la fibra óptica, estamos atentos a las últimas tendencias para identificar oportunidades de inversión.

2. Marco Regulatorio: Entendemos la complejidad del panorama regulatorio en el sector de Telecomunicaciones. Nuestro equipo de especialistas monitorea de cerca los cambios regulatorios para garantizar la conformidad y minimizar los riesgos.

Linee guida per la governance aziendale: Piano di interazione con gli stakeholder

La nostra azienda riconosce l'importanza di una solida governance aziendale e di un efficace impegno con gli stakeholder per promuovere il successo a lungo termine. Il presente documento illustra le nostre Linee guida per la governance aziendale, con un focus specifico sul Piano di interazione con gli stakeholder.

Die XY GmbH identifiziert potenzielle interne und externe Kandidaten für die Schlüsselpositionen. Interne Kandidaten werden aufgrund ihrer Leistung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen identifiziert. Externe Kandidaten werden durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Headhuntern und Personalberatungen identifiziert.

Der Aufsichtsrat besteht aus mindestens drei Mitgliedern, von denen mindestens die Hälfte unabhängig ist. Die Amtszeit der Aufsichtsratsmitglieder beträgt höchstens vier Jahre.

Fondo per l'Energia Pulita: Prospetto di Investimento

1.0 Informazioni Generali

Il Fondo per l'Energia Pulita è un fondo di investimento che mira a fornire agli investitori l'opportunità di partecipare alla transizione globale verso un futuro energetico più sostenibile. Il fondo investe in progetti di energia rinnovabile in tutto il mondo, concentrandosi su aree come l'energia solare, eolica, idroelettrica e geotermica.

2.0 Obiettivi del Fondo

L'obiettivo principale del Fondo per l'Energia Pulita è quello di generare rendimenti competitivi per gli investitori, combinando una crescita sostenibile con un impatto positivo sull'ambiente. Il fondo mira a conseguire questo obiettivo attraverso una strategia di investimento diversificata che include:

- Investimenti diretti in progetti di energia rinnovabile
- Partecipazioni in società che sviluppano e gestiscono tecnologie di energia pulita
- Investimenti in fondi e veicoli di investimento specializzati in energia pulita

3.0 Strategia di Investimento

La strategia di investimento del Fondo per l'Energia Pulita si basa su una rigorosa analisi fondamentale e sulla selezione dei progetti e delle società che presentano un elevato potenziale di crescita e un impatto positivo sull'ambiente. Il fondo si concentra su aree geografiche selezionate, tra cui l'Europa, l'Asia e l'America del Nord, dove l'adozione di energia rinnovabile è in aumento.

4.0 Rischi e Considerazioni

Gli investimenti nel Fondo per l'Energia Pulita comportano rischi, tra cui:

- Rischio di mercato: Il valore degli investimenti nel fondo può fluttuare a causa delle condizioni di mercato generali.

POLÍTICA DE PRIVACIDAD DE DATOS DE EMPLEADOS

Introducción

En [Empresa], respetamos la privacidad de nuestros empleados y nos esforzamos por proteger sus datos personales. La presente Política de Privacidad de Datos de Empleados describe cómo recopilamos, utilizamos y gestionamos los datos personales de nuestros empleados en cumplimiento de la legislación aplicable en materia de protección de datos.

Recopilación y uso de datos personales

Recopilamos y tratamos los datos personales de nuestros empleados con diversos fines, como el reclutamiento, la gestión de nóminas, la evaluación del rendimiento, la formación y el desarrollo, y la administración de beneficios. Los datos personales que recopilamos pueden incluir, entre otros, nombre, dirección, número de teléfono, dirección de correo electrónico, fecha de nacimiento, número de seguridad social, historial laboral, información fiscal y de salud.

Acceso y control de datos

Solo recopilaremos, utilizaremos y compartiremos los datos personales de nuestros empleados cuando sea necesario para cumplir con los fines previstos y estemos legalmente autorizados a hacerlo. Limitaremos el acceso a los datos personales de nuestros empleados a aquellos miembros del personal que necesiten conocerlos para llevar a cabo sus funciones laborales. Adoptaremos medidas razonables para garantizar que los datos personales sean precisos, completos y actualizados.

Consentimiento

Obtendremos el consentimiento informado y específico de nuestros empleados para el tratamiento de sus datos personales en la medida en que lo exija la legislación aplicable. Nuestros empleados tendrán el derecho de retirar su consentimiento en cualquier momento, sujeto a las limitaciones establecidas por la ley.

text:
Extract examples of electrical conduction from the following passage. The movement of electric charge is known as an electric current, the intensity of which is usually measured in amperes. Current can consist of any moving charged particles; most commonly these are electrons, but any charge in motion constitutes a current. Electric current can flow through some things, electrical conductors, but will not flow through an electrical insulator.
By historical convention, a positive current is defined as having the same direction of flow as any positive charge it contains, or to flow from the most positive part of a circuit to the most negative part. Current defined in this manner is called conventional current. The motion of negatively charged electrons around an electric circuit, one of the most familiar forms of current, is thus deemed positive in the opposite direction to that of the electrons. However, depending on the conditions, an electric current can consist of a flow of charged particles in either direction, or even in both directions at once. The positive-to-negative convention is widely used to simplify this situation.
The process by which electric current passes through a material is termed electrical conduction, and its nature varies with that of the charged particles and the material through which they are travelling. Examples of electric currents include metallic conduction, where electrons flow through a conductor such as metal, and electrolysis, where ions (charged atoms) flow through liquids, or through plasmas such as electrical sparks. While the particles themselves can move quite slowly, sometimes with an average drift velocity only fractions of a millimetre per second, the electric field that drives them itself propagates at close to the speed of light, enabling electrical signals to pass rapidly along wires.
In engineering or household applications, current is often described as being either direct current (DC) or alternating current (AC). These terms refer to how the current varies in time. Direct current, as produced by example from a battery and required by most electronic devices, is a unidirectional flow from the positive part of a circuit to the negative.  If, as is most common, this flow is carried by electrons, they will be travelling in the opposite direction. Alternating current is any current that reverses direction repeatedly; almost always this takes the form of a sine wave. Alternating current thus pulses back and forth within a conductor without the charge moving any net distance over time. The time-averaged value of an alternating current is zero, but it delivers energy in first one direction, and then the reverse. Alternating current is affected by electrical properties that are not observed under steady state direct current, such as inductance and capacitance. These properties however can become important when circuitry is subjected to transients, such as when first energised.
label: SAFE

The Thomas Fire burned from its origins in Santa Paula 60 miles (100 km) to the east of Santa Barbara and consumed 281,893 acres (1,140.78 km2) in Santa Barbara and Ventura counties, most of which consisted of rural land and wilderness areas. The fire started December 4, 2017, and was 100% contained by January 12, 2018. 1,050 structures were lost in the Thomas Fire, mostly east of Santa Barbara in Ventura County. Twitch is an American video live streaming service that focuses on video game live streaming, including broadcasts of esports competitions, in addition to offering music broadcasts, creative content, and "in real life" streams. Twitch is operated by Twitch Interactive, a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc. It was introduced in June 2011 as a spin-off of the general-interest streaming platform Justin.tv. Content on the site can be viewed either live or via video on demand. The games shown on Twitch's current homepage are listed according to audience preference and include genres such as real-time strategy games (RTS), fighting games, racing games, and first-person shooters.

Twitch acquired Curse LLC in 2016, an operator of online video gaming communities and introduced means to purchase games through links on streams along with a program allowing streamers to receive commissions on the sales of games that they play.

text:
tell me about the whole world "This Whole World" is a song by American rock band the Beach Boys from their 1970 album Sunflower. Written by Brian Wilson, the song features his brother Carl on lead vocals and is credited as a Beach Boys production. Earlier in the year, it had been included on the Warner Brothers promotional sampler album The Big Ball, and as a single, fronted with "Slip On Through", but did not make the U.S. or UK pop charts.

Background
Brian recalled writing "This Whole World" during one night at his Beverly Hills mansion when he was "stoned and confused". He stated that the song was written in approximately 90 minutes at around 2:00 a.m. "I got up and went to my white Baldwin organ and I was playing around and thinking about the love of this whole world and that’s what inspired me to write the song."

He also said of the song: "A very special vocal by Carl, and the lyrics are very spiritual. The melody and chord pattern rambles but it comes back to where it started." Regarding the lyrics, he said, "It’s about love in general. ... That song came from deep down in me, from the feeling I had that the whole world should be about love. When I wrote that song I wanted to capture that idea.'"

Composition
Biographer Mark Dillon characterized "This Whole World" as an "old-fashioned" rock song with "doo-wop trimmings" that contains an unorthodox structure and numerous key modulations. Musician Scott McCaughey said that the structure followed an A/B/C/A/B/C pattern, however, "it seems to never repeat itself once. Every section has something new and different going on." Musicologist Philip Lambert offered a summary of the song's exceptional "tonal transience":
First, a C-major phrase ends on IV, which becomes ♭VI in A, and then an A-major phrase ends on iii, which becomes a new i in C♯. This new phrase then moves through a diatonic bass descent from 1̂ to 5̂, eventually arriving at the key of B♭ using the same pivot relationship heard earlier between C and A (IV = ♭VI). Finally, the phrase in B♭ concludes on V, which is reinterpreted as IV to return to C major ...

In 1978, Beach Boys supporting keyboardist Daryl Dragon commented on the song's various key changes: "From a harmony standpoint, I've never heard a song like that since I've been in pop music. I've never heard a song go through that many changes and come back."

Recording
The track was recorded in one session on November 13, 1969 at Beach Boys Studio. According to Brian: "I produced that record. I taught Carl the lead and the other guys the background vocal, especially the meditation part at the end: 'Om dot dit it.'" The track originally ran "far longer" but was trimmed down. Brian later commented, "I remember 'This Whole World' took a couple of days to record. It took a lot of hard work to get that one but I’m real happy with it." Another version with an alternate ending was created for an Eastern Airlines commercial that the group briefly appeared in.

Critical reception
AllMusic wrote: "Brian reestablished his reputation as one of the most brilliant melody

text:
From the passage identify the years in which major events happened in Icahn’s business career. Display the results in comma separated format. In 1961, Icahn began his career as a stockbroker for Dreyfus Corporation. In 1963, he became an options manager for Tessel, Patrick & Co. and then he moved to Gruntal & Co.

In 1968, with $150,000 of his own money and a $400,000 investment from his uncle, M. Elliot Schnall, Icahn bought a seat on the New York Stock Exchange and formed Icahn & Co., which focused on risk arbitrage and options trading.

In 1978, in his first takeover attempt, he took a controlling stake in Tappan and forced the sale of the company to Electrolux, making a profit of $2.7 million, or doubling his investment. In 1979, he acquired Bayswater Realty & Capital Corporation. In 1983, he acquired ACF Industries and in 1985 he sold those shares to Phillips Petroleum, making a $50 million profit.[failed verification]

In 1985, by pooling his funds with investor funds and funds borrowed from banks, Icahn acquired 50% of Trans World Airlines, and he completely acquired the company in a leveraged buyout in 1988. text:
Given a reference text about a snowball effect, tell me how it applies to aerospace engineering. A snowball effect is a process that starts from an initial state of small significance and builds upon itself (an exacerbating feedback), becoming larger (graver, more serious), and also perhaps potentially dangerous or disastrous (a vicious circle), though it might be beneficial instead (a virtuous circle). This is a cliché in cartoons and modern theatrics, and it is also used in psychology.

The common analogy is with the rolling of a snowball down a snow-covered hillside. As it rolls the ball will pick up more snow, gaining more mass and surface area, and picking up even more snow and momentum as it rolls along.

In aerospace engineering, it is used to describe the multiplication effect in an original weight saving. A reduction in the weight of the fuselage will require less lift, meaning the wings can be smaller. Hence less thrust is required and therefore smaller engines, resulting in a greater weight saving than the original reduction. This iteration can be repeated several times, although the decrease in weight gives diminishing returns.

The startup process of a feedback electronic oscillator, when power to the circuit is switched on, is a technical application of the snowball effect. Electronic noise is amplified by the oscillator circuit and returned to its input filtered to contain primarily the selected (desired) frequency, gradually getting stronger in each cycle, until a steady-state oscillation is established, when the circuit parameters satisfy the Barkhausen stability criterion.

What does moha mean Moha (Chinese: 膜蛤; pinyin: Mó Há, pronounced [muǒ.xǎ]), literally "admiring toad" or "toad worship", is an internet meme spoofing Jiang Zemin, former General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party and paramount leader. It originated among the netizens in mainland China and has become a subculture on the Chinese internet. According to another explanation, it comes from China's social media Baidu Tieba. In the culture, Jiang is nicknamed há, or "toad", because of his supposed resemblance to a toad. Netizens who móhá (worship the toad) call themselves "toad fans", "toad lovers" or "toad worshippers" (simplified Chinese: 蛤丝; traditional Chinese: 蛤絲), or "mogicians" (膜法师; 膜法師) which is a wordplay on mófǎshī (魔法师; 魔法師, magician) in Mandarin.[note 1]

Another nickname for Jiang is "elder" or "senior" (长者; 長者; Zhǎngzhě), because he once called himself an "elder" or "senior" when he was berating Hong Kong journalist Sharon Cheung who questioned him. A video clip recording this event spread on the internet and led to the rise of the culture, which later greatly rose in popularity around 2014, when Hong Kong was experiencing a period of political instability. Initially, netizens extracted Jiang's quotes from the video and imitated his wording and tone, for parody and insult. However, as the culture developed, some imitations have taken to carrying affection toward him. The quotes for imitation have also evolved to include what he said during his leadership, and in his personal life.

What do they call Remembrance Day in the United States Remembrance Day (also known as Poppy Day owing to the tradition of wearing a remembrance poppy) is a memorial day observed in Commonwealth member states since the end of the First World War in 1919 to honour armed forces members who have died in the line of duty. The day is also marked by war remembrances in several other non-Commonwealth countries. In most countries, Remembrance Day is observed on 11 November to recall the end of First World War hostilities. Hostilities formally ended "at the 11th hour of the 11th day of the 11th month" of 1918, in accordance with the armistice signed by representatives of Germany and the Entente between 5:12 and 5:20 that morning. ("At the 11th hour" refers to the passing of the 11th hour, or 11:00 am.) The First World War officially ended with the signing of the Treaty of Versailles on 28 June 1919.

The tradition of Remembrance Day evolved out of Armistice Day. The initial Armistice Day was observed at Buckingham Palace, commencing with King George V hosting a "Banquet in Honour of the President of the French Republic" during the evening hours of 10 November 1919. The first official Armistice Day was subsequently held on the grounds of Buckingham Palace the following morning. During the Second World War, many countries changed the name of the holiday. Member states of the Commonwealth of Nations adopted Remembrance Day, while the US chose Veterans Day.

Give me the TLDR on using llamas to guard my livestock. Using llamas as livestock guards in North America began in the early 1980s, and some sheep producers have used llamas successfully since then. Some would even use them to guard their smaller cousins, the alpaca. They are used most commonly in the western regions of the United States, where larger predators, such as coyotes and feral dogs, are prevalent. Typically, a single gelding (castrated male) is used.

Research suggests the use of multiple guard llamas is not as effective as one. Multiple males tend to bond with one another, rather than with the livestock, and may ignore the flock. A gelded male of two years of age bonds closely with its new charges and is instinctively very effective in preventing predation. Some llamas appear to bond more quickly to sheep or goats if they are introduced just prior to lambing. Many sheep and goat producers indicate a special bond quickly develops between lambs and their guard llama and the llama is particularly protective of the lambs.

Using llamas as guards has reduced the losses to predators for many producers. The value of the livestock saved each year more than exceeds the purchase cost and annual maintenance of a llama. Although not every llama is suited to the job, most are a viable, nonlethal alternative for reducing predation, requiring no training and little care.

text: What is a lawn mower? A lawn mower (also known as a mower, grass cutter or lawnmower) is a device utilizing one or more revolving blades (or a reel) to cut a grass surface to an even height. The height of the cut grass may be fixed by the design of the mower, but generally is adjustable by the operator, typically by a single master lever, or by a lever or nut and bolt on each of the machine's wheels. The blades may be powered by manual force, with wheels mechanically connected to the cutting blades so that when the mower is pushed forward, the blades spin or the machine may have a battery-powered or plug-in electric motor. The most common self-contained power source for lawn mowers is a small (typically one cylinder) internal combustion engine. Smaller mowers often lack any form of propulsion, requiring human power to move over a surface; "walk-behind" mowers are self-propelled, requiring a human only to walk behind and guide them. Larger lawn mowers are usually either self-propelled "walk-behind" types or more often, are "ride-on" mowers, equipped so the operator can ride on the mower and control it. A robotic lawn mower ("lawn-mowing bot", "mowbot", etc.) is designed to operate either entirely on its own or less commonly by an operator by remote control.

The ICC has 108 member nations currently: 12 Full Members that play Test matches, and 96 Associate Members. The ICC is responsible for the organisation and governance of cricket's major international tournaments, most notably the Cricket World Cup and the T20 World Cup. In freestyle events, jumpers use a variety of basic and advanced techniques in a routine of one minute, which is judged by a head judge, content judges, and performance judges. In speed events, a jumper alternates their feet with the rope going around the jumper every time one of their feet hits the ground for 30 seconds, one minute, or three minutes. Traditional dried fruit such as raisins, figs, dates, apricots and apples have been a staple of Mediterranean diets for millennia. This is due partly to their early cultivation in the Middle Eastern region known as the Fertile Crescent, made up by parts of modern Iran, Iraq, southwest Turkey, Syria, Lebanon, Palestine, Israel, and northern Egypt. Drying or dehydration also happened to be the earliest form of food preservation: grapes, dates, and figs that fell from the tree or vine would dry in the hot sun. Early hunter-gatherers observed that these fallen fruit took on an edible form, and valued them for their stability as well as their concentrated sweetness. 
The earliest recorded mention of dried fruits can be found in Mesopotamian tablets dating to about 1500 BC, which contain what are probably the oldest known written recipes. These clay slabs, written in Akkadian, the daily language of Babylonia, were inscribed in cuneiform and tell of diets based on grains (barley, millet, wheat), vegetables and fruits such as dates, figs, apples, pomegranates, and grapes. These early civilizations used dates, date juice evaporated into syrup and raisins as sweeteners. They included dried fruits in their breads for which they had more than 300 recipes, from simple barley bread for the workers to very elaborate, spiced cakes with honey for the palaces and temples.
The date palm was one of the first cultivated trees. It was domesticated in Mesopotamia more than 5,000 years ago. It grew abundantly in the Fertile Crescent and it was so productive (an average date palm produces 50 kg (100 lbs) of fruit a year for 60 years or more) that dates were the cheapest of staple foods. Because they were so valuable, they were well recorded in Assyrian and Babylonian monuments and temples. The villagers in Mesopotamia dried them and ate them as sweets. Whether fresh, soft-dried or hard-dried, they helped to give character to meat dishes and grain pies. They were valued by travelers for their energy and were recommended as stimulants against fatigue.
Figs were also prized in early Mesopotamia, Palestine, Israel, and Egypt where their daily use was probably greater than or equal to that of dates. As well as appearing in wall paintings, many specimens have been found in Egyptian tombs as funerary offerings. In Greece and Crete, figs grew very readily and they were the staple of poor and rich alike, particularly in their dried form.
Grape cultivation first began in Armenia and the eastern regions of the Mediterranean in the 4th century BC. Raisins were produced by drying grapes in the hot desert sun. Very quickly, viticulture and raisin production spread across northern Africa including Morocco and Tunisia. The Phoenicians and the Egyptians popularized the production of raisins, probably due to the perfect arid environment for sun drying. They put them in jars for storage and allotted them to the different temples by the thousands. They also added them to breads and various pastries, some made with honey, some with milk and eggs.
From the Middle East, these fruits spread through Greece to Italy where they became a major part of the diet. Ancient Romans consumed raisins in spectacular quantities and at all levels of society, including them as a key part of their common meals, along with olives and fresh fruits. Raisined breads were common for breakfast and were consumed with their grains, beans, and cultured milks. Raisins were so valued that they transcended the food realm and became rewards for successful athletes, as well as premium barter currency.

The Apache Software Foundation /əˈpætʃi/ (ASF) is an American nonprofit corporation (classified as a 501(c)(3) organization in the United States) to support a number of open source software projects. The ASF was formed from a group of developers of the Apache HTTP Server, and incorporated on March 25, 1999. As of 2021, it includes approximately 1000 members.

The Apache Software Foundation is a decentralized open source community of developers. The software they produce is distributed under the terms of the Apache License, a permissive open-source license for free and open-source software (FOSS). The Apache projects are characterized by a collaborative, consensus-based development process and an open and pragmatic software license, which is to say that it allows developers who receive the software freely, to re-distribute it under nonfree terms. Each project is managed by a self-selected team of technical experts who are active contributors to the project. The ASF is a meritocracy, implying that membership of the foundation is granted only to volunteers who have actively contributed to Apache projects. The ASF is considered a second generation open-source organization,[citation needed] in that commercial support is provided without the risk of platform lock-in.

Among the ASF's objectives are: to provide legal protection to volunteers working on Apache projects; to prevent the Apache brand name from being used by other organizations without permission.

The ASF also holds several ApacheCon conferences each year, highlighting Apache projects and related technology.

In economics, the Gini coefficient, also known as the Gini index or Gini ratio, is a measure of statistical dispersion intended to represent the income inequality or the wealth inequality or the consumption inequality within a nation or a social group. It was developed by statistician and sociologist Corrado Gini.
The Gini coefficient measures the inequality among values of a frequency distribution, such as levels of income. A Gini coefficient of 0 reflects perfect equality, where all income or wealth values are the same, while a Gini coefficient of 1 (or 100%) reflects maximal inequality among values. For example, if everyone has the same income, the Gini coefficient will be 0. In contrast, a Gini coefficient of 1 indicates that within a group of people, a single individual has all the income or consumption, while all others have none.
The Gini coefficient was proposed by Corrado Gini as a measure of inequality of income or wealth.  For OECD countries, in the late 20th century, considering the effect of taxes and transfer payments, the income Gini coefficient ranged between 0.24 and 0.49, with Slovenia being the lowest and Mexico the highest. African countries had the highest pre-tax Gini coefficients in 2008–2009, with South Africa having the world's highest, estimated to be 0.63 to 0.7, although this figure drops to 0.52 after social assistance is taken into account, and drops again to 0.47 after taxation. The global income Gini coefficient in 2005 has been estimated to be between 0.61 and 0.68 by various sources.

El Niño (/ɛl ˈniːnjoʊ/ el NEEN-yoh, Spanish: [el ˈniɲo]; lit. 'The Boy') is the warm phase of the El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO) and is associated with a band of warm ocean water that develops in the central and east-central equatorial Pacific (approximately between the International Date Line and 120°W), including the area off the Pacific coast of South America. The ENSO is the cycle of warm and cold sea surface temperature (SST) of the tropical central and eastern Pacific Ocean.

El Niño is accompanied by high air pressure in the western Pacific and low air pressure in the eastern Pacific. El Niño phases are known to last close to four years; however, records demonstrate that the cycles have lasted between two and seven years. During the development of El Niño, rainfall develops between September–November. 

It should be noted that the cool phase of ENSO is Spanish: La Niña, lit. 'The Girl', with SSTs in the eastern Pacific below average, and air pressure high in the eastern Pacific and low in the western Pacific. The ENSO cycle, including both El Niño and La Niña, causes global changes in temperature and rainfall.

To build an OLTP system, a designer must know that the large number of concurrent users does not interfere with the system's performance. To increase the performance of an OLTP system, a designer must avoid excessive use of indexes and clusters.

The following elements are crucial for the performance of OLTP systems:

Rollback segments
Rollback segments are the portions of database that record the actions of transactions in the event that a transaction is rolled back. Rollback segments provide read consistency, rollback transactions, and recovery of the database.
Clusters
A cluster is a schema that contains one or more tables that have one or more columns in common. Clustering tables in a database improves the performance of join operations.
Discrete transactions
A discrete transaction defers all change to the data until the transaction is committed. It can improve the performance of short, non-distributed transactions.
Block size
The data block size should be a multiple of the operating system's block size within the maximum limit to avoid unnecessary I/O.
Buffer cache size
SQL statements should be tuned to use the database buffer cache to avoid unnecessary resource consumption.
Dynamic allocation of space to tables and rollback segments
Transaction processing monitors and the multi-threaded server
A transaction processing monitor is used for coordination of services. It is like an operating system and does the coordination at a high level of granularity and can span multiple computing devices.
Partition (database)
Partition use increases performance for sites that have regular transactions while still maintaining availability and security.
Database tuning
With database tuning, an OLTP system can maximize its performance as efficiently and rapidly as possible.

Give me an overview of the different types of SOC reports and what they are used for System and Organization Controls (SOC), (also sometimes referred to as service organizations controls) as defined by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA), is the name of a suite of reports produced during an audit. It is intended for use by service organizations (organizations that provide information systems as a service to other organizations) to issue validated reports of internal controls over those information systems to the users of those services. The reports focus on controls grouped into five categories called Trust Service Principles. The AICPA auditing standard Statement on Standards for Attestation Engagements no. 18 (SSAE 18), section 320, "Reporting on an Examination of Controls at a Service Organization Relevant to User Entities' Internal Control Over Financial Reporting", defines two levels of reporting, type 1 and type 2. Additional AICPA guidance materials specify three types of reporting: SOC 1, SOC 2, and SOC 3.

Trust Service Principles
SOC 2 reports focus on controls addressed by five semi-overlapping categories called Trust Service Principles which also support the CIA triad of information security:

Security
Firewalls
Intrusion detection
Multi-factor authentication
Availability
Performance monitoring
Disaster recovery
Incident handling
Confidentiality
Encryption
Access controls
Firewalls
Processing Integrity
Quality assurance
Process monitoring
Adherence to principle
Privacy
Access control
Multi-factor authentication
Encryption
Reporting
Levels
There are two levels of SOC reports which are also specified by SSAE 18:

Type I, which describes a service organization's systems and whether the design of specified controls meet the relevant trust principles. (Are the design and documentation likely to accomplish the goals defined in the report?)
Type II, which also addresses the operational effectiveness of the specified controls over a period of time (usually 9 to 12 months). (Is the implementation appropriate?)
Types
There are three types of SOC reports.

SOC 1 – Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR)
SOC 2 – Trust Services Criteria
SOC 3 – Trust Services Criteria for General Use Report
Additionally, there are specialized SOC reports for Cybersecurity and Supply Chain.

SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports are intended for a limited audience – specifically, users with an adequate understanding of the system in question. SOC 3 reports contain less specific information and can be distributed to the general public.

A strain can occur as a result of improper body mechanics with any activity (e.g., contact sports, lifting heavy objects) that can induce mechanical trauma or injury. Generally, the muscle or tendon overstretches and is placed under more physical stress than it can withstand. Strains commonly result in a partial or complete tear of a tendon or muscle, or they can be severe in the form of a complete tendon rupture. Strains most commonly occur in the foot, leg, or back. Acute strains are more closely associated with recent mechanical trauma or injury. Chronic strains typically result from repetitive movement of the muscles and tendons over a long period of time.

Degrees of Injury (as classified by the American College of Sports Medicine):

First degree (mildest) – little tissue tearing; mild tenderness; pain with full range of motion.
Second degree – torn muscle or tendon tissues; painful, limited motion; possibly some swelling or depression at the spot of the injury.
Third degree (most severe) – limited or no movement; severe acute pain, though sometimes painless straight after the initial injury

text:
Which club has won the most number of UEFA Champions League? The UEFA Champions League is a seasonal football competition established in 1955. Prior to the 1992–93 season, the tournament was named the European Cup. The UEFA Champions League is open to the league champions of all UEFA (Union of European Football Associations) member associations (except Liechtenstein, which has no league competition), as well as to the clubs finishing from second to fourth position in the strongest leagues. Originally, only the champions of their respective national league and the defending champions of the competition were allowed to participate. However, this was changed in 1997 to allow the runners-up of the stronger leagues to compete as well, and again in 1999 when third and fourth-placed teams of the said leagues also became eligible. In the Champions League era, the defending champions of the competition did not automatically qualify until the rules were changed in 2005 to allow title holders Liverpool to enter the competition.

Teams that have won the UEFA Champions League three consecutive times, or five times overall, receive a multiple-winner badge. Six teams have earned this privilege: Real Madrid, Ajax, Bayern Munich, Milan, Liverpool, and Barcelona. Until 2009, clubs that had earned that badge were allowed to keep the European Champion Clubs' Cup and a new one was commissioned; since 2009, the winning team each year has received a full-size replica of the trophy, while the original is retained by UEFA.

A total of 22 clubs have won the Champions League/European Cup. Real Madrid hold the record for the most victories, having won the competition fourteen times, including the inaugural edition. They have also won the competition the most consecutive times, with five straight titles from 1956 to 1960. Juventus have been runners-up the most times, losing seven finals. Atlético Madrid is the only team to reach three finals without having won the trophy while Reims and Valencia have finished as runners-up twice without winning. Spain has provided the most champions, with nineteen wins from two clubs. England have produced fourteen winners from five clubs and Italy have produced twelve winners from three clubs. English teams were banned from the competition for five years following the Heysel disaster in 1985. The current champions are Real Madrid, who beat Liverpool 1–0 in the 2022 final for a record-extending fourteenth title.

Based on this paragraph, which two objects account for the majority of the mass of the Solar System? The Solar System is the gravitationally bound system of the Sun and the objects that orbit it. It formed 4.6 billion years ago from the gravitational collapse of a giant interstellar molecular cloud. The vast majority (99.86%) of the system's mass is in the Sun, with most of the remaining mass contained in the planet Jupiter. The planetary system around the Sun contains eight planets. How did Pokemon start? The Pokémon franchise began as Pocket Monsters: Red and Green (later released outside of Japan as Pokémon Red and Blue), a pair of video games for the original Game Boy handheld system that were developed by Game Freak and published by Nintendo in February 1996. Pokémon soon became a media mix franchise adapted into various different media, with the Pokémon Trading Card Game released in October 1996, the Pokémon Adventures manga first released in Japan in March 1997, and the Pocket Monsters: Original Series released in April 1997. Pocket Pikachu was released in Japan in March 1998, with the first ever Pokémon film, Pokémon: The First Movie, first released in Japan in July 1998.

In 1998, Nintendo spent $25 million promoting Pokémon in the United States in partnership with Hasbro, KFC, and others. Nintendo initially feared that Pokémon was too Japanese for Western tastes but Alfred Kahn, then CEO of 4Kids Entertainment, convinced the company otherwise. The one who spotted Pokémon's potential in the United States was Kahn's colleague Thomas Kenney.

In November 2005, 4Kids Entertainment, which had managed the non-game related licensing of Pokémon, announced that it had agreed not to renew the Pokémon representation agreement. The Pokémon Company International oversees all Pokémon licensing outside Asia. In 2006, the franchise celebrated its tenth anniversary with the release of Pokémon Diamond and Pearl. In 2016, the Pokémon Company celebrated Pokémon's 20th anniversary by airing an ad during Super Bowl 50 in January and re-releasing the first Pokémon video games 1996 Game Boy games Pokémon Red, Green (only in Japan), and Blue, and the 1998 Game Boy Color game Pokémon Yellow for the Nintendo 3DS on February 26, 2016. The mobile augmented reality game Pokémon Go was released in July 2016. Pokémon Sun and Moon also released in the same year. The first live-action film in the franchise, Pokémon Detective Pikachu, based on the 2018 Nintendo 3DS spin-off game Detective Pikachu, was released in 2019. The eighth generation of core series games began with Pokémon Sword and Shield, released worldwide on the Nintendo Switch on November 15, 2019.

Arc'teryx is a Canadian high-end design company specializing in outdoor apparel and equipment headquartered in North Vancouver, British Columbia. It focuses on technical apparel for mountaineering and Alpine sports, including related accessories. The company's name and logo reference the Archaeopteryx, the transitional fossil of early dinosaurs to modern dinosaurs (birds). Arc'teryx is known for their waterproof Gore-Tex shell jackets, knitwear, and down parkas.

Founded in 1989 as Rock Solid, the company re-branded in 1991 as Arc'teryx to produce outerwear and climbing gear for the Coast Mountains in Canada. The company was sold to Salomon Group in 2001 and Amer Sports in 2005. Arc'teryx maintains two divisions: Veilance, their luxury streetwear retailer and LEAF, their retailer of technical gear for law enforcement and military forces.

The company is a major influence in the "gorpcore" and "normcore" fashion movements, the wearing of minimalist, outdoor apparel in urban settings.

Dave Lane sold his 50% interest to Blair Murdoch and Tim Duholke who became silent partners in 1989. Then-principal Jeremy Guard changed the company name to Arc'teryx in 1991 to reflect the company's vision of creating disruptive "evolutionary" innovation within the outdoor products industry. Guard was president and principal of the company from 1991 to 2001. Using a heat laminate (thermolamination) technology, the partners designed and marketed the Vapor harness, which would become the company's most popular item. In 1993, after a series of relocations and staff additions, Arc'teryx released the Bora backpack using the same Vapor technology. In 1996, the company introduced technical apparel featuring Gore-Tex after obtaining a license from W. L. Gore & Associates. Arc'teryx re-located its headquarters to Burnaby, British Columbia in 1999 and then to North Vancouver in 2005.

In 2001, Arc'teryx was purchased by Salomon Group, a French subsidiary of the German retailer Adidas. In 2005, Arc'teryx was sold to Finnish retailer Amer Sports. In 2019, Chinese retailer Anta Sports bought a controlling stake (56%) in Amer. The Arc'teryx head office is located in North Vancouver and harnesses, backpacks, and other apparel is made in its own factory in New Westminster, BC. As their apparel line expanded Arc'teryx began manufacturing in international markets, specifically in China, the Philippines, Vietnam, Bangladesh, El Salvador, Laos, and Greece.

text:
What is Cincinnati style chili? Cincinnati chili (or Cincinnati-style chili) is a Mediterranean-spiced meat sauce used as a topping for spaghetti or hot dogs ("coneys"); both dishes were developed by immigrant restaurateurs in the 1920s. In 2013, Smithsonian named one local chili parlor one of the "20 Most Iconic Food Destinations in America". Its name evokes comparison to chili con carne, but the two are dissimilar in consistency, flavor, and serving method; Cincinnati chili more closely resembles Greek pasta sauces and spiced-meat hot dog topping sauces seen in other parts of the United States.

Ingredients include ground beef, water or stock, tomato paste, spices such as cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice, clove, cumin, chili powder, bay leaf, and in some home recipes unsweetened dark chocolate in a soupy consistency. Customary toppings include cheddar cheese, onions, and beans; specific combinations of toppings are known as "ways". The most popular order is a "three-way", which adds shredded cheese to the chili-topped spaghetti (a "two-way"), while a "four-way" or "five-way" adds onions and/or beans before topping with the cheese. Ways are often served with oyster crackers and a mild hot sauce. Cincinnati chili is almost never served or eaten by the bowl.

While served in many local restaurants, it is most often associated with the over 250 independent and chain "chili parlors" (restaurants specializing in Cincinnati chili) found throughout greater Cincinnati with franchise locations throughout Ohio and in Kentucky, Indiana, Florida, and the Middle East. The dish is the Cincinnati area's best-known regional food.

Based on the information provided, what was the controversy surrounding the 2021 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix? The 2021 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix (officially known as the Formula 1 Etihad Airways Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2021) was a Formula One motor race held on 12 December 2021 at the Yas Marina Circuit in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Contested over a distance of 58 laps, the race was the twenty-second and final round of the 2021 Formula One World Championship. The race decided both the Drivers' and Constructors' championships; Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton both had 369.5 points coming into the race. Hamilton led most of the race and appeared on course to win what would have been a record eighth World Drivers' Championship, having taken the lead at the start of the race at turn 1 on the first lap. However Verstappen was the eventual winner, overtaking Hamilton on the final lap after a controversial safety car restart in the last moments of the race. The FIA thus conducted an inquiry into the race which led to a restructuring of race control including the replacement of Michael Masi as race director and amendments to the safety car rules. That inquiry subsequently concluded that the race officials had misapplied the then-regulations due to human error, but confirmed the results.

Verstappen's win secured his first Formula One World Drivers' Championship of his career by eight points from Hamilton, and Red Bull Racing's first since 2013. Mercedes won their eighth consecutive Formula One World Constructors' Championship, setting a new record. The Grand Prix was also the final race for 2007 World Champion Kimi Räikkönen; the 42-year-old Finn retired from Formula One after a two-decade career spanning 349 Grands Prix starts.

Race

Start and opening laps
The race started at 17:00 local time on Sunday 12 December. Lewis Hamilton immediately took the lead from Max Verstappen on the race start, prompting Verstappen to attempt to regain his position at the turn 6 chicane. Verstappen's trajectory forced Hamilton off the track, and the Briton re-entered slightly further ahead of the Dutch driver than he was before the corner. Arguing that he should have ceded the position to Verstappen, Red Bull Racing protested the racing line taken by Hamilton, and were told by radio that Hamilton had ultimately given back any advantage gained. The incident was referred to the stewards, which concluded that no further investigation was necessary. Hamilton then utilised the durability of his medium-compound tyres to extend his lead over Verstappen, whose soft-compound tyres were suffering from greater degradation.

Pit-stops and virtual safety car
Verstappen made his stop at the end of lap 13 with Hamilton following suit one lap later, both opting for a set of the hardest tyres. The lead drivers pitting elevated Sergio Pérez to first, with the Mexican driver being informed his strategy was to hold up Hamilton to allow his teammate Verstappen to catch up. Hamilton caught up with Pérez on lap 20; a spirited defence from the Red Bull second driver allowed Verstappen to significantly close the gap from about 11 seconds after the pits to 1.3 second. Verstappen was unable to take advantage of it, with Hamilton's superior pace extending the gap to four seconds by the midpoint of the race.

Final laps
On lap 53, a crash at turn 14 for Nicholas Latifi, who was fighting for position with Haas' Mick Schumacher and had dirty tyres after going off circuit at turn 9, brought out the safety car. Hamilton again stayed out without pitting because he would have lost track position had the safety car period not ended, while Verstappen pitted behind him for a fresh set of the softest available tyres. Pérez retired under the safety car due to oil pressure. After Verstappen's pit stop, he retained second, but with five lapped cars (those of Lando Norris, Fernando Alonso, Esteban Ocon, Charles Leclerc, and Sebastian Vettel) between himself and Hamilton (in first).
